questions.q: True or false? Just watch the ball, not the runner.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. Keep checking the ball and the runner, so nobody gets free.
choiceExplanations: If you only watch the ball, the runner sneaks behind you toward goal.
Right, it's false. Keep checking the ball and the runner, so nobody gets free.

questions.q: Put the defending in order, from first to last.
options: Check the ball and the runner
Runner moves inside, you go too
Right defender picks up the runner
questions.explain: Yes. Check both, move with the runner, then hand the runner to the right defender.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Check both, move with the runner, then hand the runner to the right defender.

questions.q: Now the runner cuts back left. Tap where the left defender goes.
questions.explain: Yes. The runner came to your side, so you stay close and mark them.
choiceExplanations: The right defender already has the ball side, so the runner would be free.
That is away from the runner, so they can run free toward our goal.
